children: ASYAD SHIPPING COMPANY SAOG - ANNOUNCES SALE OF TWO VLCCS SEEB AND SAMAIL ON SEPT 18, 2026
ASYAD SHIPPING COMPANY SAOG - VLCC SALE DEAL PRICE IS OMR 61.7 MILLION (US$160.2 MILLION)
RECEIPT OF A DEPOSIT PAYMENT/ADVANCE PAYMENT RELATING TO SALE OF ITS TWO VLCCS, SEEB AND SAMAIL ON THE 18 OF SEPTEMBER 2026
ASYAD SHIPPING COMPANY SAOG - EXPECTS AGGREGATE POSITIVE PROFIT IMPACT OF OMR 29 MILLION (US$75.2 MILLION)
ASYAD SHIPPING COMPANY SAOG - PROFIT IMPACT TO BE RECOGNIZED IN 2026 AND 2027
ASYAD SHIPPING - WILL CONTINUE TO OPERATE SAMAIL UNTIL OCTOBER/NOVEMBER 2026 AND SEEB UNTIL MID-JANUARY 2027
ASYAD SHIPPING - PROCEEDS FROM TRANSACTIONS ARE EXPECTED TO BE RECEIVED UPON SUCCESSFUL DELIVERY OF THE VESSELS
